title: IdentitySessionCreatedPayload
description: Payload of `identity.session.created` version 1: a user signed in and a session was created; the session id is the `sid` claim of the access tokens issued for it. Refreshing a session does not publish this event. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

session_id.description: The session that was created, the `sid` claim of its access tokens.
